Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones, evidence asks, and the proposed sequencing of contracts (MSA / DPA / Order Form). High level proposal:

- Pilot kickoff: week of Jul 6 (technical onboarding + baseline eval)
- Evidence collection window: Jul 6–Jul 23 (SOC2 snippets, network evidence, sample audit logs)
- Pilot acceptance & acceptance review: Jul 24–Jul 28
- Target for signature of MSA + DPA + Order Form (concurrent sign): Aug 6

Two notes about sequencing: we recommend completing the DPA sign-off in parallel with MSA review to avoid a second round of signatures — we usually attach the DPA as an exhibit and include a single signing event for efficiency. If procurement requires a separate PO before signature, we can support a conditional order form that references an issued PO.

I’ve included an evidence checklist and a working MAP in the attachment (ApexCardio_MAP_v2.xlsx). Can you confirm the names for:

- Procurement contact who will issue the PO (if needed)
- Legal contact for redlines on the MSA/DPA
- Final signatory for the order form (title is fine)

If those owners look right, I’ll loop in Karthik from Legal and ask Laura to adjust the timeline if procurement needs longer.

Thanks — aiming to keep this tight so the pilot handoff & procurement close happen without blocking the engineering timeline.

Best,
Rachel

Thanks for the context — outlining legal sequencing and practical turnarounds below. Attaching a short redline summary for visibility (Redlines_MSADPA_Apex_20260629.pdf).

- Preferred sequencing: countersign MSA first, execute DPA concurrently (DPA as exhibit is fine). Order Form should be signed as the final commercial document, ideally in the same signing event to avoid multiple signature rounds.
- Typical internal turnaround: 3–5 business days for initial redline, additional 2–3 days for counterparty comments. If ApexCardio legal provides advance procurement terms, we can compress to 48–72 hours.
- SOC2 / evidence: accept timeboxed exports as Laura suggested; add an evidence exhibit to the MAP that references the export package and retention window. We’ll include liability caps and data retention exceptions in the exhibit.
- Payment / PO: Redwood can accept a PO in advance of final signature only under a conditional order form (we will add a clause: execution of pilot services subject to issuance of PO within X days). If procurement insists on PO-before-signature, finance will need to confirm acceptance of that risk.

Next steps: I’ll send a single consolidated redline (MSA + DPA as exhibits) by EOD Tue and a suggested clause for conditional order forms. Laura — if you can confirm whether ApexCardio can provide procurement terms in the next 48 hours that would help compress the schedule.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
